name: GetContactSummary
label: Get Salesforce Contact Summary
description: Retrieves summary information about a Contact, such as count of related opportunities, cases, etc.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.label: Contact ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Contact to summarize (required).

fields.name: SummaryData
fields.label: Summary Data
fields.description: The summary data as a JSON string (e.g., opportunity count, case count).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce.
